FILE.ROLE: MQTT protocol core: connection registry, input framing loop, per-packet dispatch, CONNECT/CONNACK policy with client-id eviction, SUBSCRIBE/SUBACK policy with in-place filter replacement, QoS 0 publish fan-out with per-recipient enqueue isolation, EOF draining and session reaping.

DATA.NAME: enum broker_result
DATA.ROLE: Continue or close outcome of handling one packet

ENUM_VALUES.NAME: BROKER_CLOSE
ENUM_VALUES.ROLE: Session is or must be closed

DATA.NAME: struct broker
DATA.ROLE: Opaque registry of active connections; definition is private to src/broker.c

INTERFACE.NAME: broker_create
INTERFACE.ROLE: Create an empty registry

INTERFACE.NAME: broker_destroy
INTERFACE.ROLE: Destroy all sessions and the registry

INTERFACE.NAME: broker_accept
INTERFACE.ROLE: Adopt an accepted descriptor as a new session

INTERFACE.NAME: broker_process_input
INTERFACE.ROLE: Consume all complete frames from the session input buffer

INTERFACE.NAME: broker_session_eof
INTERFACE.ROLE: Drain complete frames then close after flush

INTERFACE.NAME: broker_reap
INTERFACE.ROLE: Promote drained CLOSING sessions and destroy CLOSED ones

INTERFACE.NAME: broker_session_count
INTERFACE.ROLE: Registry iteration bound

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: struct session *broker_session_at(const struct broker *b, size_t index)
INTERFACE.NAME: broker_session_at
INTERFACE.ROLE: Registry iteration accessor

DATA.NAME: BROKER_INITIAL_SESSION_CAP
DATA.ROLE: Initial registry capacity in session slots

DATA.NAME: BROKER_INITIAL_SUB_CAP
DATA.ROLE: Initial subscription slots requested per session

DATA.NAME: CONNACK_UNACCEPTABLE_PROTOCOL_LEVEL
DATA.ROLE: CONNACK return code 0x01 sent when the protocol level is not 4

DATA.NAME: CONNACK_IDENTIFIER_REJECTED
DATA.ROLE: CONNACK return code 0x02 sent for an empty or non-ASCII client identifier

DATA.NAME: GRANTED_QOS
DATA.ROLE: Granted QoS reported in every SUBACK result code (this broker grants QoS 0)

DATA.NAME: struct broker
DATA.ROLE: Private registry definition: session pointer array plus a reusable encode scratch buffer

FIELDS.NAME: sessions
FIELDS.ROLE: Owned array of owned session pointers

FIELDS.NAME: scratch
FIELDS.ROLE: Reusable buffer holding one encoded outbound PUBLISH; cleared with buffer_consume after fan-out

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static void remove_session_at(struct broker *b, size_t index)
INTERFACE.NAME: remove_session_at
INTERFACE.ROLE: Destroy the session at index and shift the tail down

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static int add_session(struct broker *b, int fd, struct session **out_session)
INTERFACE.NAME: add_session
INTERFACE.ROLE: Create a session and append it to the registry, growing the array if needed

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static enum broker_result handle_connect(struct broker *b, struct session *s, const struct wire_connect *c)
INTERFACE.NAME: handle_connect
INTERFACE.ROLE: Apply CONNECT policy, store the client id, send CONNACK, evict a same-id READY session

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static enum broker_result handle_subscribe(struct broker *b, struct session *s, const struct wire_subscribe *sub)
INTERFACE.NAME: handle_subscribe
INTERFACE.ROLE: Store each filter QoS 0 and queue the SUBACK with one granted code per filter in order

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static enum broker_result handle_publish(struct broker *b, struct session *s, const struct wire_publish *pub)
INTERFACE.NAME: handle_publish
INTERFACE.ROLE: Reject QoS 1/2 and DUP-with-QoS-0, otherwise fan out one QoS 0 copy

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static enum broker_result handle_pingreq(struct broker *b, struct session *s)
INTERFACE.NAME: handle_pingreq
INTERFACE.ROLE: Queue PINGRESP

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static enum broker_result handle_disconnect(struct broker *b, struct session *s)
INTERFACE.NAME: handle_disconnect
INTERFACE.ROLE: Close the connection immediately without flushing

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static void route_publish(struct broker *b, const struct wire_publish *pub)
INTERFACE.NAME: route_publish
INTERFACE.ROLE: Encode one QoS 0 PUBLISH into scratch and enqueue it to every READY matching session, including the publisher, closing only a failing recipient

INTERFACE.NAME: broker_create
INTERFACE.ROLE: Allocate the registry and its scratch buffer

INTERFACE.NAME: broker_destroy
INTERFACE.ROLE: Destroy every session, free the arrays and the scratch buffer

INTERFACE.NAME: broker_accept
INTERFACE.ROLE: Take ownership of fd through add_session

INTERFACE.NAME: broker_process_input
INTERFACE.ROLE: Frame, dispatch, consume; stop on INCOMPLETE, close on INVALID or non-CONNECT before CONNECT

INTERFACE.NAME: broker_session_eof
INTERFACE.ROLE: Process buffered complete frames, then enter CLOSING with the queue preserved

INTERFACE.NAME: broker_reap
INTERFACE.ROLE: Close drained CLOSING sessions and destroy CLOSED sessions

INTERFACE.NAME: broker_session_count
INTERFACE.ROLE: Return count (0 for NULL)

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: struct session *broker_session_at(const struct broker *b, size_t index)
INTERFACE.NAME: broker_session_at
INTERFACE.ROLE: Borrowed session pointer or NULL when out of range

PUBLIC_SYMBOLS.NAME: broker_session_at
